verdict.label: separate
verdict.why: The only overlap is calling `with_raw_response.create(**data, timeout=timeout)` and then `parse()`. That is the standard OpenAI SDK call pattern, and it targets different endpoints: `chat.completions` in NEW (sync) and `completions` in EXISTING (async). The rest differs. NEW also extracts headers and handles output-token-limit BadRequestError by building a fallback response. EXISTING handles client creation, pre-call logging, conversion to a chat model response, and mapping errors to AzureOpenAIError. There is no shared policy or sequence that would justify a common helper.
